rules.description: This engine's PGLite data directory, Postgres URL or Rust store path, replaced by <DATABASE>.
This engine's throwaway directory (its GBRAIN_HOME, exports and store), replaced by <ENGINE_DIR>.
The run work directory (the shared corpus lives under it), replaced by <WORK>.

ISO-8601 date-times written at run time (created_at, updated_at, ingested_at and the like), replaced by <TS:shape>, where the shape keeps every separator and the digit count (for example <TS:####-##-##T##:##:##.###Z>), so a change of precision, zone form or separator is still a difference. The fixed corpus mtime is kept.
Random UUIDs (page revisions, generated request and write ids), replaced by <UUID-n> numbered in order of first appearance within one output, so equal ids stay equal.
Wall-clock durations under keys naming a duration, elapsed time, latency or milliseconds, replaced by the string "<DURATION>" so JSON stays parseable.
The whole object under a "timings" key (search's per-stage wall-clock breakdown, whose stage keys also come out in completion order), replaced by the string "<TIMINGS>".
